summary: Attribute daemon background CPU and poll counts to static task names, preserve writer submitters' accounting, and scope reconcile cost counters to classified background passes only

schema.detail: CPU counters and task scopes are in memory only. The reconcile cost-counter metric covers classified background passes only: completed startup, notification, deadline and changed-repeat trigger spans and their SQL. Direct/unclassified passes, next-deadline callbacks and async polls are excluded. The direct_or_unknown remainder is not measured and is omitted rather than exported as zero. Process CPU remains whole-process CPU, not classified-pass CPU.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: OTel gains st.task.cpu_time (seconds) and st.task.polls with bounded st.task labels. Operator-visible /performance request-kind replacements: roster/refresh -> published_list.agents; roster/warm -> startup.warmup; missions/refresh -> published_list.missions; work/refresh -> published_list.work; startup open-store -> startup.open_store; startup judge-claims -> startup.judge_claims; startup validate-replication-backlog -> startup.validate_replication_backlog; startup apply-replication-repairs -> startup.apply_replication_repairs; startup settle-runs -> startup.settle_runs; startup project-replication-backlog -> startup.project_replication_backlog; task enforce-account-limits -> account_limits.enforce; task coordination-counts-catch-up -> maintenance.coordination_counts; task stop-deferral-history -> maintenance.stop_deferral_history; task expire-completed-responses -> maintenance.response_expiry; task account-limits-catch-up -> account_limits.catch_up; task trim-local-observations -> observations.trim; task checkpoint -> maintenance.checkpoint; task migrate-event-payloads -> maintenance.event_payloads; task mailbox-wake-dispatch -> mailbox.wake_dispatch. Existing profile slow.jsonl operation labels (the JSON field is label, not kind) make the same replacements where a file-profile operation existed; roster/warm and roster/refresh previously only recorded performance tasks and now also create file-profile operations. Nested task reconcile-pass and task reconcile-deadline retain their /performance kinds, but their slow.jsonl operation label and writer origin become reconcile because the outer blocking scope owns the profile operation. Writer origin values task checkpoint, task migrate-event-payloads, task expire-completed-responses, task coordination-counts-catch-up, task account-limits-catch-up, task enforce-account-limits, task trim-local-observations and task mailbox-wake-dispatch make the replacements above; previously unrecognized labels (including startup, roster, published lists and task stop-deferral-history) were other and now use the admitted dotted task name. New bounded scopes can also replace previously unlabeled profile work or other writer origins: publication.attention, publication.summary, publication.advance_evidence, publication.evidence, publication.evidence_ready, replication.activate, replication.retry_projection, replication.export, replication.receive, replication.exchange, replication.outbound, replication.connectivity, replication.dial_peer, replication.fabric_exposure, replication.fabric_presence, replication.fleet_view, replication.peer_failure, replication.publish_endpoints, replication.settings, replication.tailnet, replication.worker, startup.isolation, maintenance.envelope_payloads, maintenance.wal_checkpoint, maintenance.malloc_relief, maintenance.response_expiry_clock, maintenance.response_expiry_deadline, observations.trim_usage_responses, observations.database_size, observations.export, operations.repair_drift, recorder.receipts, mailbox.own_post, mailbox.write, mailbox.subscription, message_body.reconcile, seat.snapshot_transfer, runtime.start, sekrets.import, changes.discover, changes.sync, account_limits.ready, allocator.trim, config.reload_policies, github.auth, github.request, profile.runtime_lag, reconcile.supervise, reconcile.timer, reconcile.gate_poll, slo.export, slo.history, terminal.socket, terminal.tunnel, terminal.view_dispatch, terminal.view_watch, tile.endpoint and tile.endpoints. Existing nested performance stages such as roster/*, attention/refresh, person-views/refresh and summary/refresh are not renamed. Shared writer setup/finalization previously appeared as unlabeled writer-thread profile work; they now use writer.batch.setup and one writer.batch.commit (including postcommit callbacks). writer.batch.job measures each executed SAVEPOINT/callback/RELEASE or ROLLBACK sequence under its captured submitter profile; st.task is aggregate job CPU, not per-origin CPU. Nested scopes count invocations but not duplicate CPU. Batch holds telemetry also changes timing: WriterHold is recorded/removed and the OTel Holding holder cleared after postcommit work and before the first ACK, rather than after all ACK sends. Holder totals/maxima, long holds and over-target counts exclude ACK-channel delay, and no prior holder is reported during ACK delivery; the writer may still be blocked sending ACKs. COMMIT and observers still precede ACKs. Update label-based queries; no compatibility aliases or historical-series continuity are promised. HTTP route names are not renamed.

downtime.detail: Only the usual daemon restart to install the build.

manual.detail: Update label-based performance/profile/writer-origin queries using the replacements above. Verification: Intake rename/docs/filter, per-job savepoint scope, single commit scope and hold-timing corrections are implemented; no local build/test/formatter or measurement was run. Overhead MEASUREMENT PENDING explicit capacity approval: an N-job batch now has N+2 outer blocking scopes plus any nested wrappers, not a demonstrated lower cost. At the prior f9cdcfb8 head, Performance run 38817109803 job 116705075586 first failed while compiling the link-minutes quarantine (SIGKILL, sccache signal 9); the link test did not execute. Later daemon_cost passed 9/9 and outbound passed 1/1. OOM is not proven and this is not an attributed st2#3079 test failure. Correction head 9ffe5473 then failed producer compilation with E0502: its shared commit closure captured connection while the transaction retained its mutable borrow; the canary stopped at its producer guard. A synchronous thread-bound lexical accounting guard now spans sequential transaction consumption and postcommit reads without capturing either borrow, retaining one commit invocation and profile-before-CPU-flush/before-ACK drop ordering. Added existing-file success/nesting/unwind and callback/lexical equivalence coverage; this repair remains locally uncompiled and unexecuted pending independent source review and authorized hosted verification. Prior-head results are not repair-head verification or Intake acceptance.

recovery.detail: The previous binary can be restored; no state is persisted.
